title: In-Place Home Resale Inspection Charge and the Age of the Home: Training Questions
content:
**Rule.** On an In-Place Home Resale package whose inspection fee is above 0.00, the initial inspection charge carries a home-age addition, one of the inspection additions billed with that charge. The home-age addition follows the home's age in the calendar year of the inspection, taken as the inspection's year less the model year on the seller's Home-Site Lease: an age of 15 years or more adds 35.00, an age of at least 8 but fewer than 15 years adds 15.00, and an age of fewer than 8 years adds nothing.

| Age (inspection year less model year) | Home-age addition |
|---|---|
| 15 years or more | 35.00 |
| 8 to 14 years | 15.00 |
| fewer than 8 years | 0.00 |

## Questions answered by the rule

**Which year is the home's age measured in?** The calendar year of the initial inspection, whatever the month: an inspection on 3 January 2026 and one on 28 December 2026 both measure the age in 2026.

**Where does the model year come from?** From the home as recorded on the seller's Home-Site Lease.

**A home of model year 2011 inspected in 2026?** Age 15: 35.00.

**A home of model year 2012 inspected in 2026?** Age 14: 15.00.

**A home of model year 2018 inspected in 2026?** Age 8: 15.00.

**A home of model year 2019 inspected in 2026?** Age 7: nothing is added.

(The years in these answers are hypothetical.)
